Practice Test 3
 Have the UI design reviewed against its wireframe (image files are
attached in the Appendix for reference) by a GPT model (ChatGPT,
Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.) from a UI test analyst’s perspective.
 Were you able to follow the prompt structure used in the course
example? Did you make any improvements to the prompt for a
better outcome?
 Which GPT model provided the most satisfactory results?
 Were you able to transfer the review results into the required format?

www.infiniticreation.co.uk
Practice Test 4
 What prompt would you use to get the best user experience
recommendation for the following page?
https://infinitehealing.co.uk/checkout/
 How satisfied are you with the outcome generated by your prompt?
 On a scale of 0 to 10 (with 10 being excellent), how would you rate
the current page based on the outcome of your prompt?
 Which GPT model provided the best results?
